summary: Pedro Santana Lopes (born 1956) is a politician who succeeded Durão Barroso as leader of the Social Democratic Party and as prime minister in July 2004, and who left the office in March 2005 after the President dissolved the Assembly and called an election. He is in the atlas as the head of government between Durão Barroso’s departure and the election of 2005.
